_about: Religious words that must never appear in Zad X Kids text (owner decision 2026-11-22, docs/decisions/ZADX-KIDS-VARIANT.md). The ONLY copy of the list: used by test/kids_variant_test.dart (ARB strings, brand/store config, praise, tasks, schedules) and backend/functions/test/security.test.js (assistant prompt). English entries match whole words, case-insensitive. Arabic entries match anywhere in the text (Arabic attaches prefixes such as al-, wa-, bi-). Words left out on purpose because they are also everyday words: 'جزء' (part), 'عيد' (inside 'سعيد'/'بعيد'), 'نبي' (inside 'تنبيه'), 'ذكر' (inside 'تذكير'), 'سنة' (year), 'جامع', 'حديث' (inside 'تحديث'), 'قارئ' (reader).
